title: Make a mark
slide_intent: Show how a single shape can organize a long run of visual messages. Repetition can connect panels while changes of scale and color keep them distinguishable.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can carry one campaign voice across a street-facing installation using alternating portraits, color fields and a single name panel.
demonstration: A photograph fills the page. Six adjacent billboard panels alternate figure-shaped photo windows and a dark panel carrying the blue wordmark.
practical_value: Use a wide contextual view to check recognition and pacing across the whole run of posters.

content_islands.name: Overlay header
content_islands.spec: Set the short title and navigation directly over the darker upper-left foliage in light type.

content_islands.name: Billboard sequence
content_islands.spec: Show the complete billboard against the trees and pavement. Retain the border, successive color fields and central name panel so scale and order can be read together.
